purpose: Document local registry evidence, language-specific searches and bounded anonymous geometry-route review.
assessment: The official Jhang district Revenue Department identifies efficient land-record management as a district function and publishes Jhang tehsil revenue-estate/mouza and staff coverage. Punjab Land Records also exposes village-wise cadastral-map selectors, including Jhang in the PLRA public map catalogue. This establishes a local revenue/cadastral workflow, not an anonymously accessible urban parcel-vector layer or citywide coverage. No sample retained. Official map pages establish cadastral-map availability, but an anonymous feature endpoint/schema and geometry-only response for the exact WUP point were not verified.

Official Punjab PULSE viewer advertises Jhang under Cadastral Maps; enhanced parcel details show a login gate, which was not used.
